data_note: SYNTHETIC simulated randomized trial (K re-randomized cohorts, reported per test split), test split only; self-normalized IPW and doubly-robust estimates; true_* columns use the hidden simulated effects. Truth is grounded in our own save-rate assumptions (partly circular); not measured lift. Net value = 24-month margin net of offer cost (annoyance excluded). Simulated 50k trial (35k train / 15k test accounts x 20 re-randomized cohorts): targeted policies (Model B, Model C, oracle) separate from offer-to-everyone, the 3+ calls rule and random beyond noise; Model B vs Model C vs oracle do NOT separate on net value (paired 95% CIs cross 0, see policy_pairwise.csv)
